description: AXIS FIX — the cave was adding spin to the WRONG component. The static analysis assumed a Y-up basis, but eFootball is Unreal-based and uses Z-UP (X fwd, Y right, Z up). Under Z-up the Magnus cross product gives: spin about Y -> PURELY VERTICAL force (the ball flying upwards, exactly as observed), spin about Z -> purely HORIZONTAL curl (the slice we want). The cave was writing [r14+4] (=Y, the lift axis); this moves it to [r14+8] (=Z, the vertical spin axis that produces sideways curl). Two displacement bytes.

patches.name: cave: add spin to the Z (vertical) axis, not Y — sideways curl instead of lift
